title: PolicyGuard: policy-as-code enforcement + config-drift detection & automated remediation for compliance controls
creator: Jordan Lee
description: Implement a PolicyGuard subsystem to codify data residency and retention policies as executable policies (policy-as-code), continuously detect configuration drift across Hosted/Dedicated/Private deployments, and provide safe automated remediation paths plus audit-grade evidence/reporting. This ticket covers design and initial implementation of the enforcement engine, the drift scanner, remediation actions and the evidence export pipeline. Goal is to give customers deterministic enforcement of residency/retention settings and reduce compliance manual effort.
acceptance_criteria: A policy repository with at least 5 canonical policies for data residency and retention (examples: region_denylist, tenant_retention_max_days, kv_cache_persistence_disabled) stored in git and reviewed
Enforcement hook integrated with model-serving config push that blocks non-compliant config changes in CI or emits a clear blocking error for interactive Console ops

Drift scanner runs nightly and detects config differences between desired (policy repo) and actual deployment configs across Hosted/Dedicated/Private; drift alerts surface in Console and create tickets when high-impact

Automated remediation workflows available for a safe subset of drifts (e.g., retention exceeded, region mismatch) with a one-click rollback or policy-enforced patch and an audit log entry for each action
Evidence/reporting export endpoint that generates a signed compliance bundle (JSON + metadata) containing detected drifts, remediations taken, timestamps, and operator IDs
End-to-end tests demonstrating detection -> remediation -> evidence generation on a staging Dedicated cluster
technical_notes: Prototype with Open Policy Agent (Rego) for policy-as-code evaluation; policies stored under infra/policies in a dedicated repo
Drift scanner implemented as a controller service that queries runtime configs via existing config API and compares against canonical policy-derived desired state
Remediation actions executed through the same operator path used by infracontrol; remediation runs with audited service account and requires 2-step approval for high-risk changes
Evidence bundles signed with KMS key (customer-managed for Private/VPC) and stored in S3-like object store with retention aligned to customer settings
Expose telemetry events (policy.violation.detected, policy.remediation.executed) to Console observability pipelines for SLA and metrics dashboards
Keep drift detection lightweight: initial phase runs nightly with incremental scans; later add near-real-time hooks on config change events
Security review required for the remediation surface to ensure no privilege escalation paths; coordinate with Security and Legal
tasks: Create policy repo skeleton and add canonical data residency/retention Rego examples
Build enforcement CI hook to validate infra changes against policies
Implement drift-scanner service and nightly job in staging cluster
Design remediation playbooks and integrate operator path for safe fixes
Add evidence export API and wire KMS signing for bundles
Instrument telemetry and Console alerting for violations/drift
Write runbook and acceptance tests; schedule security review
